gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-mul: Heavy and blunt: Impact Label hits hard, its c's ending in pincers that point apart. But Noto Sans Multani does the finer work, with a lofty x-height and an e whose terminal gapes wide.

gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-nag: Heavy and loud, Impact Label owns the top, its c's ends splayed like pincers. But Noto Sans Nag Mundari is built for the text itself, its curves half unwrapped and its lowercase rivaling the capitals.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-nan: Impact Label hits with heavy, commanding weight, its c's ends flaring apart. Noto Sans Nandinagari then fills in beneath with generous openings and short ascenders, so the heavy heading gets a friendly partner.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-new: Heavy and imposing, Impact Label slams down a hard-hitting first line. Noto Sans Newa lets the text breathe beneath that heavy line, with a clearly open e and generous bowls.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-nus: Text here reads light and modern, with terminals held far from the stroke body and a towering x-height. Noto Sans Nushu is the real draw, easing the weight of Impact Label with all that open space.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-ogh: Noto Sans Ogham gaps its e wide and lifts its lowercase so high that it looks bold. Noto Sans Ogham holds its own beside Impact Label, and that sturdy presence is the pair's best trait.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-ol-: Clean and contemporary, Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds its curve tails well back, so words read as solid blocks. And beside Impact Label, the text feels lighter, more like a quiet foil than a rival.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-old: Generous counters and apertures stay open at tiny sizes, which makes Noto Sans Old Hungarian approachable and contemporary. Impact Label brings the muscle up top, while the body does the reading.
